name: Terapify
one_liner: Spanish-language video therapy with independent psychologists, booked and paid per 50-minute session; based in Mexico, also marketed to Latinos in the US.
best_for: Spanish speakers who want therapy in their own language
People in Mexico or Latin America who want affordable per-session online therapy
Couples who want Spanish-language couples therapy
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 in the US, or local emergency services
People who need medication or psychiatric care
People in the US who need a therapist licensed in their state or who want to use insurance
short_description: Spanish-language online therapy marketplace for Mexico, Latin America and Spanish speakers abroad, paid per session.
long_description: Terapify is a Mexico-based online platform that connects people with independent Spanish-speaking psychologists for video sessions of 50 or 100 minutes, individual or couples, through its website and app. Session prices are standardized (they do not change by psychologist) and charged in local currency; its Mexico homepage shows MXN 769 per session, and session packages lower the per-session price. International cards and PayPal are accepted for USD payments. It runs US-facing pages for Spanish speakers and says sessions can be in Spanish or English, but it does not state that its psychologists are licensed in individual US states. Terapify describes itself as an intermediary rather than a provider of care, says its professionals cannot prescribe medication through the platform, and directs people in crisis to local emergency services.

pricing.starting_price: MXN 769/session in Mexico; other currencies on its price page
pricing.notes: Pay per 50-minute session or buy a package at a lower per-session price. Prices are the same for every psychologist and are charged in local currency; a USD price was not verified. First-session guarantee: if there is no fit, the next session is free. No insurance billing.

privacy.notes: Mexican privacy notice offers access, correction and cancellation (ARCO) rights; the parts read do not say whether data is used for advertising. No regulatory action found.

faqs.q: What is Terapify and who is it for?
faqs.a: Terapify is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.
Terapify pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.
Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

patient_summary: Terapify is a Spanish-language marketplace where you pick a psychologist (or take its matching quiz) and have 50-minute video sessions, individual or couples. You pay per session or buy a discounted package, in local currency; if the first session isn't a good fit you can book another with a different psychologist at no extra cost. The psychologists are independent professionals, they cannot prescribe medication through the platform, and it is not for emergencies.

availability.note: Spanish-language service based in Mexico, serving Latin America and Spanish speakers abroad, including US-facing pages; US state licensure of its psychologists is not stated.
